addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Elements package
Added Media Elements with local and YouTube support
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support

change.item: Built using modern Joomla 6 MVC architecture and PHP 8.2+
Optimized frontend rendering for lightweight and high-performance websites
Improved administrator interface and workflow for managing reusable elements
Optimized database queries and rendering performance
Improved compatibility with Cloudflare and production environments

security.item: Added ACL support for administrator operations
Added CSRF protection for administrator actions
Added URL validation and input sanitization
Added SQL parameter binding for all database operations
Added secure Import and Export validation
Built for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.2+ using modern namespaces and production-safe architecture

note.item: Initial public stable release of DevArt Elements for Joomla 6
Built for Joomla 6 only with PHP 8.2+
Designed for lightweight, reusable and production-ready content elements
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment
